content.title: Full Masters schedule: How to watch 2026 tournament at Augusta National
content.text: April 8, 2026, 1:19 p.m. ETThe 2026 Masters Tournament is here and the first golf major of the year arrives with no shortage of headlines. With 91 of the world’s best golfers set to tee off Thursday, April 9, this year’s field feels more wide open than most, with several top players navigating personal milestones and uneven recent form.World No. 1 Scottie Scheffler arrived at Augusta as a father of two for the first time, having time away to welcome his newborn son in the lead-up to the tournament. Defending champion Rory McIlroy will look to shake off a disappointing Players Championship, where a lingering back injury contributed to a tie for 46th place.This year’s event will also be without two of golf’s biggest names. Tiger Woods will miss the Masters for the second consecutive year following an arrest in March, and he announced he is stepping away from the sport to focus on his well-being. Phil Mickelson is also absent, withdrawing due to an unspecified family health matter.Here is the full Masters schedule so you don’t miss a moment of the action from Augusta National.When is the 2026 Masters?The 90th annual Masters Tournament is set to begin on Thursday, April 9, with the final round on Sunday, April 12.How to watch the 2026 Masters?The 2026 Masters will be broadcast on CBS, Golf Channel, and ESPN, with extra coverage via the Masters App and Masters.com.
